from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from datetime import datetime
import re

# Use existing tokens and note data
simple_note_token = res.get('access_token')
amazon_token = res_amz.get('access_token')
note_id = 3084

# Recompute month total from already-fetched month_orders if available, else fetch
now = datetime.now()
month = now.month
year = now.year
month_key = f"{month:02d}/{str(year)[-2:] }"  # e.g., 05/23
month_key = month_key.replace(' ','')

# If month_orders already computed earlier, use it; else compute quickly
try:
    month_orders
    month_total_decimal = sum(Decimal(str(o.get('paid_amount',0.0) or 0.0)) for o in month_orders)
except NameError:
    # fetch orders and filter
    all_orders=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.amazon.show_orders(access_token=amazon_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_orders.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    month_orders=[]
    for o in all_orders:
        created=o.get('created_at')
        if not created:
            continue
        dt=datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace('Z',''))
        if dt.year==year and dt.month==month:
            month_orders.append(o)
    month_total_decimal = sum(Decimal(str(o.get('paid_amount',0.0) or 0.0)) for o in month_orders)

# Format money: keep up to 2 decimals, but strip trailing zeros and ensure at least one decimal
# Determine decimal places present by quantizing to 2 decimals then trimming
q = month_total_decimal.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
# Convert to string with trimming of trailing zeros
s = format(q, 'f')
if '.' in s:
    s = s.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
    if '.' not in s:
        s = s + '.0'
# Ensure we don't end up with scientific notation
money_str = s

entry_line = f"- {month_key} => ${money_str}"
print('month_key', month_key)
print('month_total_decimal', month_total_decimal)
print('formatted money_str', money_str)
print('entry_line', entry_line)

# Load current note content from earlier note variable if still in scope
try:
    existing_content = note.get('content','')
except NameError:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
    existing_content = note.get('content','')

print('existing contains month_key?', month_key in existing_content)

# If month line exists, we'll update by replacing the line; else append
pattern = re.compile(rf"^\s*-\s*{re.escape(month_key)}\s*=>\s*\$[^\n]*$", re.MULTILINE)
match = pattern.search(existing_content)

if match:
    # replace the matched line
    new_content = pattern.sub(entry_line, existing_content)
    print('will update existing line')
    upd = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token, content=new_content)
    print('update_note response', upd)
else:
    print('will append new entry')
    res_add = apis.simple_note.add_content_to_note(note_id=note_id, append_or_prepend='append', added_content=entry_line, access_token=simple_note_token)
    print('add_content_to_note response', res_add)
